dct_description_sm: The purpose of this initiative was to select success stories from projects funded under both the Climate Change Adaptation Program and the ecoEnergy for Aboriginal and Northern Communities Program, showcasing accomplishments in Aboriginal and northern communities in terms of climate change adaptation and energy efficiency projects.
